req.title: Task has default completed=false
req.statement: The system shall default the completed field to false when POST /tasks/ omits it.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-016 requires that POST /tasks/ defaults completed=false when the field is omitted. Tests must verify: (1) positive — omitting completed yields completed=false in response with HTTP 201; (2) negative — explicitly sending completed=true is accepted and returns true (proving the default is not hardcoded to always false); (3) boundary — omitting completed alongside a minimal-length title (1 char) still defaults to false; (4) additional EP — omitting completed with a description present still defaults to false; (5) DT — sending completed=false explicitly also returns false (distinguishing default from explicit). Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (201 not 200), exact boolean value (False not just falsy), exact field names, and testing both sides of the boolean.

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_post_task_omit_completed_defaults_to_false():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"title": "Test default completed"}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert body["title"] == "Test default completed"
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
